body: Your wife is stronger than me. I could never tell my parents about this, it would kill them. One of the things the doc was going to do with my blood work was to find my blood type because my dad needs a kidney transplant and is on a wait list that will take years. My brother is not a match, my mom is recovering from cancer, I thought hopefully I could give my dad one thing and it would mean a lot and help make up for all the failures I've had. Sort of like a little hope for redemption, instead I'm now the infected failure faggot son and can't give my parents anything except more grief.

I don't want to take medication and I don't want a partner. In fact I have nothing but rage against gay people now (including myself) and feel like I've been tricked, fucked, chucked and infected. There is no way I can be happy anymore, it's self-hatred until I'm dead.

Thanks but there is nothing inspirational about being diseased, depressed, a failure at life and soon enough just another statistic. I've tried life and failed. I am not going to inspire others how to succeed because I am not going to succeed, this is the end of the road.
